features.title: Code and sorcery
features.text: Technomancers prepare arcane spells as programs. A programming language determines which gear they can overclock with magic left over from a spell.

features.title: Overclock and jailbreak
features.text: Cast a non-cantrip spell, then Overclock Gear to boost compatible equipment. Jailbreak spends that boost to add a spellshape and its extra effects to the next spell.
